title: Emo/hardcore woman
content: I know this is a shot in the dark, but I was curious if I ran into anyone here. I had a very realistic feeling dream where I had a conversation with a white woman probably in her late 20s/early 30s with an emo style (all black clothes, black hair, etc.) We were in a normal, Craftsman bungalow style house with a white fence, \[sort of like this\](https://share.google/vBWYeMvogkXZteo59). We talked about bands and you gave me a recommendation for a hardcore band, whose name I forget, but was a similar style to As I Lay Dying. Just curious, because this dream felt real, yet somewhat mundane as far as my dreams usually go, which made it feel even more real. Is this any of you?
